name: Blount-Bridgers House
unique: An 1808 Federal house museum with period rooms and a gallery of regional art, on the edge of Tarboro's colonial town common.
buzz: The house and the common together make the visit. Small, cheap and well kept.

name: Imperial Centre for the Arts
unique: An arts center in a converted tobacco warehouse with galleries, a theater, a children's museum and studios, beside the old mill district.
buzz: More going on than expected for the size of the town, with cheap tickets and changing shows.

name: Moratock Park
unique: A riverside park around the stone foundations of an 1840s iron furnace, with a swimming hole, a picnic area and the Dan River running through.
buzz: The furnace ruins are the surprise and the river is the swim. Good after a Hanging Rock hike.

name: Mountain Gateway Museum
unique: A regional museum of mountain life with a log cabin, farm tools, a moonshine still and the story of the railroad climb up the Blue Ridge.
buzz: Free and genuinely interesting, especially the railroad and moonshine rooms. A good rainy day stop.

name: Craggy Gardens
unique: A high heath bald on the Blue Ridge Parkway, covered in rhododendron and blueberries, with a short trail to a 360 degree view.
buzz: The June rhododendron bloom is spectacular and the drive is half the experience. Bring a jacket and check the parkway closures.

name: Caldwell County Courthouse
unique: A neoclassical courthouse on a main street of early 20th century storefronts, in a furniture mill town at the foot of the mountains.
buzz: A quick stop on the way to Wilson Creek. The square is improving.

name: Granville County Courthouse
unique: An 1830s courthouse remodeled in the early 1900s, on a square of antique shops and law offices in a town full of antebellum houses.
buzz: The building anchors a good walk. Pair it with the museum and the farmers market.

name: Satterwhite Point
unique: A Corps recreation area on Kerr Lake with a sandy swimming beach, picnic shelters, a boat ramp and a fishing pier.
buzz: The beach is shallow and shady, good for kids. Get there early on summer weekends.

name: Carolina Horse Park
unique: A 500 acre equestrian competition venue with cross country courses, arenas and a calendar of horse trials, polo and clinics.
buzz: Even non riders enjoy the cross country phase, where horses gallop past on grass. Check the calendar before driving out.

name: St. Andrews University
unique: A small liberal arts campus with a lake, brick buildings and a Scottish heritage, in the Sandhills.
buzz: Quiet and green, with a lake walk and a coffee shop. A pleasant stop if you are in town.

name: Duplin County Courthouse
unique: A courthouse on a wide lawn with a Confederate monument and old oaks, in a town of handsome houses and a historic inn.
buzz: A quick stop with Liberty Hall nearby. The lawn and the oaks are the photo.

name: Sampson County Courthouse
unique: A neoclassical courthouse with columns and a clock, on a square of brick storefronts in the middle of hog and tobacco country.
buzz: A five minute look on the downtown walk. The square is quiet.
